fields.evidence: A HashSet<ls::AttachmentInfo> (48 bytes) written as an opaque block: the build allows no struct of the layout's own as a hash-set key. Windows type name ls::FieldMeta<class ls::HashSet<struct ls::AttachmentInfo,struct ls::HashTableOpsDefault> ls::PhysicsSkinnedConnectionComponent::*,0>; macOS m_AttachmentInfos. Windows replication writer bg3.exe+0x3AB46A0 passes the member (FieldMeta offset global DAT_1462D06C8) to bg3.exe+0x3AB7120, which writes the key count from +0x2C and walks the key array at +0x20 with stride 0x10 - the HashSet shape (buckets +0, next +0x10, keys +0x20). Key ls::AttachmentInfo, 16 bytes: +0 EntityHandle (entity writer FUN_144017090 at the never-assigned offset global DAT_1462D06E8, so 0; the reader builds fresh keys from the null-handle constant), +8 FixedString, +0xC FixedString (ecs::sync::Serialize(FixedString) on both; default -1). Member names of AttachmentInfo unknown.
